objectives.text: Identify three common risks for this course's API in described endpoints: broken object level authorization (API1), broken authentication (API2) and broken function level authorization (API5) from the OWASP API Security Top 10 2023; the full list is optional reference
Identify broken object level authorization in a described endpoint and the ownership check that fixes it
Connect earlier course practices (validation, DTOs, error bodies without internals, password hashing, role checks) to the risks they reduce
